releases.notes:
### New
- Hunger bar stays visible when riding a boat, minecart or other entity without health
- Fixed the sky shaking when the time of day is frozen ([MC-17675](https://mojira.dev/MC-17675))
- Texture packs can use the full texture size your graphics card supports
- Mods can no longer light things past full brightness
- Server disconnect reasons can be logged
- Improve terrain loading speed on servers
- Faster block entity rendering

### Fixes
- Redstone dust update order is no longer broken (removed a bad optimization from 1.1.1)
- Missing armor textures in languages with non-ASCII digits
- Unreadable images show the missing texture instead of crashing
- Crash when `usercache.json` is empty
- Several server list pinger bugs
- Name tags show changes other mods make to entity names again

### Miscellaneous
- `sarcio:disable` now takes feature names instead of mixin class names
